test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 21 Oct, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Find the simple interest (in ₹) on ₹2500 as a sum borrowed at 5% per year rate of interest for 5 years.
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹2500

Rate of Interest (R) = 5% per year

Time (T) = 5 years

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) / 100

**Calculation:**

SI = (₹2500 × 5 × 5) / 100

⇒ SI = (2500 × 25) / 100

⇒ SI = 62500 / 100

⇒ SI = ₹625

**The simple interest is ₹625.**
